title: rapanea verae-crucis
intro: Rapanea verae-crucis, commonly known as New Zealand holly, is a plant species native to New Zealand. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, aiding in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Rapanea verae-crucis include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may contribute to its potential in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
